NONE: B1 a piece of writing in which the words are arranged in separate lines, often ending in rhyme, and are chosen for their sound and for the images and ideas they suggest
詩

example: a book of love poems
愛情詩集
The poet recited some of her recent poems.
詩人朗誦了她最近寫的幾首詩。

NONE: › a condition of the blood that causes damage to the nerves, resulting in weakness of the arms and legs, as well as abnormal changes in the liver, spleen, and endocrine system. POEMS is an acronym of the main features: polyneuropathy, organomegaly, endocrinopathy, monoclonal gammopathy and skin changes
POEMS症候群（包括多發性神經病變、臟器腫大、內分泌病變、M蛋白和皮膚改變。POEMS是 polyneuropathy、organomegaly、endocrinopathy、monoclonal gammopathy和skin changes的縮寫）
B1 a person who writes poems
詩人
› in the UK, a poet given a special position by the king or queen, who is asked to write poems about important public occasions
（英國）桂冠詩人

example: that most illustrious Poet Laureate, Alfred Lord Tennyson
那位最傑出的桂冠詩人艾爾福雷德•丁尼生勳爵

NONE: C2 like or relating to poetry or poets
詩的，詩歌的
› approving very beautiful or expressing emotion
極美的；充滿詩意的；詩情畫意的

example: a collection of Dryden's poetical works (= poems)
德萊頓詩集
The story is written in richly poetic language.
這篇故事的語言充滿詩意。
Deanne Sokolin creates abstract, mournfully poetic black-and-white images of wrapped objects.
迪恩•索科林的被圍繞包裹起來的物體創造了抽象、憂傷而充滿詩意的黑白影像。

NONE: › an occasion when something bad happens to a person who seems to deserve it, usually because of bad things that person has done
報應，應得的懲罰

example: What poetic justice it is that Brady has to go to court to plead to be allowed to die, just like his innocent victims pleaded to be allowed to live.
布萊迪不得不上法院懇求處死，就如同當初無辜的受害者懇求免於一死一樣，真是報應。

NONE: › the act by a writer or poet of changing facts or rules to make a story or poem more interesting or effective
詩的破格；藝術變通手法

example: She used a fair amount of poetic licence when describing her life in rural France.
她在描述自己在法國鄉村的生活時，發揮了一定程度的藝術想像力。

NONE: B1 poems in general as a form of literature
（總稱）詩，詩歌
› a very beautiful or emotional quality
詩意

example: contemporary poetry and prose
當代詩歌散文
She started writing poetry at a young age.
她年紀很小就開始寫詩了。
This film has a savage poetry and brilliance.
這部電影具有野性的詩意和才情。
